description: This file contains PHP code for generating reports on requirement-based test results within the TestLink open source testing platform. It initializes templates, manages database interactions, processes test requirements and linked test cases, evaluates requirement coverage, and constructs data tables for reporting purposes.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class representing an external table used for rendering data, with supports for grouping, sorting, and adding custom behaviors.

methods.name: build_req_spec_description
methods.description: Builds a descriptive string for requirement specifications, including requirement counts and statuses.

methods.name: evaluate_req
methods.description: Determines the evaluation status of a requirement based on test case counters and configured algorithms.

methods.name: comment_percentage
methods.description: Converts a numerical percentage value into a string with a padded comment for sorting purposes in ExtJS.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes user input arguments from request/session data for report generation.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Constructs and initializes the GUI object with page settings and platform info.

methods.name: setUpLabels
methods.description: Prepares label mappings for requirement statuses, types, and evaluation labels.

methods.name: setUpReqStatusCfg
methods.description: Configures status code mappings, labels, and evaluation states for reporting.

methods.name: buildReqSpecMap
methods.description: Builds a mapping of requirement specifications and their related test cases for report processing.

methods.name: doNotRunAnalysis
methods.description: Analyzes test execution status counts to determine requirement evaluation, especially when test cases have not run.
